notes: New: Meal Plan. In the small hours before a shopping day the hub has Claude plan the week's dinners from your preferences, the pantry and the recipe box; the plan waits on the Meal Plan page until you press Use, which puts a dinner on the dinner calendar, saves a new recipe to the recipe box and puts what the pantry says is low on the shopping list. Pantry photos: photograph a shelf, the fridge or the freezer and tap Add or No on what Claude sees. A cooked dinner now nudges its ingredients down in the pantry.
